message:
All tests pass now: 2 of 2.

The bug was in `src/vat.js`. `withVat` used `Math.floor(pence * 1.2)`, so it truncated instead of rounding to the nearest penny, as its comment says. For 999p the result was 1198 instead of 1199. I changed it to `Math.round(pence * 1.2)`.

I also checked the floating-point concern. For every integer from 0 to 1,000,000, `Math.round(p * 1.2)` matches exact integer arithmetic, so the change doesn't introduce rounding drift.

I didn't commit the change, since you didn't ask for a commit.
